title: Accounting connections
description: Sort 16 accounting words into four groups.

groups.name: People
groups.explanation: People who work in accounting or work with an accountant.

groups.name: Documents
groups.explanation: Papers or files you read, write or keep.

groups.name: Company results
groups.explanation: Money numbers that show how a company is doing.

groups.name: Money and payments
groups.explanation: Words about paying and receiving money.
